leaf.name: Leaf
leaf.note: Rota mais difícil: exige sair cedo da vila e farmar em Danger Zones nos níveis mais altos.
leaf.noteEn: Hardest route: you have to leave the village early and farm in Danger Zones at higher levels.

sand.name: Sand
sand.note: Grind mais fácil: as áreas de treino ficam perto da vila.
sand.noteEn: Easiest grind: training areas are close to the village.

mist.name: Mist
mist.note: Segunda mais fácil, mas isolada (5 min de barco). Os seals de Mist ficam dentro da vila (Ikayasu) e liberam o Sealed Temple.
mist.noteEn: Second easiest, but isolated (5 min by boat). Mist's seals are inside the village (Ikayasu) and unlock the Sealed Temple.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.note: Ninja sem vila: renasce de graça em Takumi e pega as missões com o Daimyo de lá. As rotas usam o território Rogue, em volta de Takumi.
rogue.noteEn: Village-less ninja: respawns for free in Takumi and takes missions from the Daimyo there. Routes use Rogue Territory, around Takumi.

fire.name: Fire
fire.tip: Multi-alvo e dano alto: junte grupos de mobs e limpe em área.
fire.tipEn: Multi-target and high damage: pull groups of mobs and clear them with AoE.

wind.name: Wind
wind.tip: Rápido, afiado e letal: ótimo para rotacionar spawns sozinho.
wind.tipEn: Fast, sharp and lethal: great for rotating spawns solo.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.tip: Dano alto e imobilização: prenda o mob enquanto ataca.
lightning.tipEn: High damage and immobilization: lock the mob down while you attack.

earth.name: Earth
earth.tip: Área ampla e controle de grupo: segura vários mobs de uma vez.
earth.tipEn: Wide AoE and crowd control: holds several mobs at once.

water.name: Water
water.tip: Equilibrado e versátil: rende bem em qualquer zona.
water.tipEn: Balanced and versatile: performs well in any zone.

medical.name: Medical
medical.tip: Cura, revive e veneno: rende mais em time, principalmente nos arcos.
medical.tipEn: Healing, revive and poison: best in a team, especially during arcs.

weapon.name: Weapon
weapon.tip: Técnicas de armas e ferramentas ninja.

pt.title: Pergaminho do Leveling
pt.subtitle: Escolha vila e maestria, depois clique em um nível.
pt.footer: Rotas de guias da comunidade (fórum Nin Online e Steam). Confirme no jogo.
pt.noMissions: Nenhuma missão nesta faixa: foco no grind e nas dailies.
pt.suggestGeneral: Viu algo errado? Sugira uma correção
pt.dailiesEarly: Até o 15, as diárias dão pouco XP (180–2.020): guarde as 4 do dia e farme.
pt.dailiesRogue: Rogue não pega diárias da vila: as missões vêm do Daimyo em Takumi.
pt.noDailies: Nenhuma diária com nível confirmado neste nível.

en.title: Leveling Scroll
en.subtitle: Pick your village and mastery, then choose a level.
en.footer: Routes from community guides (Nin Online forum and Steam). Check in game.
en.noMissions: No missions in this range: focus on grinding and dailies.
en.suggest: Suggest a correction for this level
en.suggestGeneral: Spotted a mistake? Suggest a correction
en.dailiesEarly: Until 15, dailies give little XP (180–2,020): save your 4 for the day and farm.
en.dailiesRogue: Rogues don't get village dailies: their missions come from the Daimyo in Takumi.
en.noDailies: No daily with a confirmed level gate at this level.

TEXT_EN.Suba pela escada perto da academia e vá: Take the stairs near the academy and go right. Safe zone. Do the village starter missions and don't spend your dailies yet.
West of the village entrance. Safe zone. Do the village starter missions and don't spend your dailies yet.
TEXT_EN.Saída leste, no início da bifurcação. Zo: East exit, at the start of the fork. Safe zone. Do the village starter missions and don't spend your dailies yet.
TEXT_EN.Rogue renasce em Takumi: as Larvas ficam: Rogues respawn in Takumi: the Larvae are at the village entrance.
TEXT_EN.Mesma rota da academia. Bom para subir j: Same route as the academy. Good for leveling jutsu too.
TEXT_EN.Guarde Scorpion Tails para missões futur: Keep your Scorpion Tails for later missions.
Windy Pond also has Foxes for later.
Spiderling and Dragonfly (Lv 5) give 37 XP. Oak Trail also has Foxes for later.
TEXT_EN.Wolf (Nv 9) dá 67 XP. Farme junto com as: Wolf (Lv 9) gives 67 XP. Farm alongside the starter missions until 10. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Fox (Nv 9) dá 67 XP. Farme junto com as: Fox (Lv 9) gives 67 XP. Farm alongside the starter missions until 10. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Stingers até o 10, depois Coyotes (Nv 9,: Stingers until 10, then Coyotes (Lv 9, 67 XP), alongside the starter missions. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Fox e Wolf (Nv 9) dão 67 XP. Guarde as 4: Fox and Wolf (Lv 9) give 67 XP. Save your 4 dailies until 15: the first ones only give 180–2,020 XP.
TEXT_EN.Wolf (Nv 9) dá 67 XP e Crazy Spider (Nv: Wolf (Lv 9) gives 67 XP and Crazy Spider (Lv 10) 370. Leaf seals can only be turned in at 20, but you can start collecting them.
TEXT_EN.Coyote (Nv 9) dá 67 XP e Big Scorpion (N: Coyote (Lv 9) gives 67 XP and Big Scorpion (Lv 10) 370. Sand seals can only be turned in at 20, but you can start collecting them.
Fox (Lv 9) gives 67 XP and Boar (Lv 13) 97. Mist seals can only be turned in at 20, but you can start collecting them.
TEXT_EN.Fox e Wolf (Nv 9) dão 67 XP. Missões de: Fox and Wolf (Lv 9) give 67 XP. Rogue missions come from the Daimyo in Takumi.
TEXT_EN.Melhor grind da faixa: cerca de 200–300k: Best grind in this range: about 200–300k XP/h, depending on Danger Zones.
TEXT_EN.Builds corpo a corpo seguem nas feras da: Melee builds stay on the village beasts until 15.
TEXT_EN.Builds corpo a corpo seguem nas feras at: Melee builds stay on the beasts until 15.
TEXT_EN.Rota de Intelligence para maestrias elem: Intelligence route for elemental masteries. Tiger (Lv 13) gives 97 XP and White Tiger (Lv 17) 127.
Intelligence route for elemental masteries. Scarab (Lv 13) gives 97 XP.
Intelligence route for elemental masteries. Boar (Lv 13) gives 97 XP and Black Boar (Lv 17) 127. The Sealed Temple only opens with the Mist seals mission (Lv 20).
TEXT_EN.Tunneler (Nv 17) dá 127 XP. No 20, os se: Tunneler (Lv 17) gives 127 XP. At 20, the Sand seals unlock the Secret Desert Cavern, with Big Scarabs (Lv 23).
TEXT_EN.White Tiger e Tunneler (Nv 17) dão 127 X: White Tiger and Tunneler (Lv 17) give 127 XP.
TEXT_EN.Arco rende 3–4 níveis (+1 com World Bles: The arc gives 3–4 levels (+1 with World Blessing). Farm the mobs inside the train.
TEXT_EN.Secret Desert Cavern (após os seals de S: Secret Desert Cavern (after the Sand seals)
Keep your Bear Paws: they are needed for missions later.
TEXT_EN.Combine com as dailies e o RP Mission IV: Combine with dailies and RP Mission IV.
TEXT_EN.Combine com as dailies do Daimyo em Taku: Combine with the Daimyo's dailies in Takumi and RP Mission IV.
TEXT_EN.Rende 3–4 níveis. Cuidado no puzzle: os: Gives 3–4 levels. Careful in the puzzle: the last tiles kill instantly.
TEXT_EN.Aceite no balcão da vila. Rende 2–3 níve: Accept it at the village mission desk. Gives 2–3 levels with Blessing. The 40s are the slowest range: dailies help a lot.
TEXT_EN.Questline mais difícil em tempo e mobs,: The hardest questline in time and mobs, but its bosses drop top-tier weapons.
TEXT_EN.Fonte principal de XP fora do arco: Main XP source outside the arc
TEXT_EN.Entre pelo NPC Lv.60 Arc, perto do Guren: Enter through the Lv.60 Arc NPC, near Guren (100 Ryo). The story up to The Memory Lane gives ~1.18M XP. Bakezori (61) gives 457 XP and Chochin (62) 465.
TEXT_EN.Tsuchigumo (64) dá 472 XP e Kappa (65),: Tsuchigumo (64) gives 472 XP and Kappa (65) 480. Since July 7, 2026 there are no more Kappa in Spiritflow River.
TEXT_EN.Blue Oni (68) e Black Oni (69) dão 510–5: Blue Oni (68) and Black Oni (69) give 510–517 XP. The cave opens with The Whispering Well. Watch out for the Red Oni (boss, Lv 70).

TEXT_EN.Mobster Questline em Kinsen Quarters (an: Mobster Questline in Kinsen Quarters (formerly Tanzaku)
TEXT_EN.Dull Edges and Sharp Minds: derrotar Gur: Dull Edges and Sharp Minds: defeat Guren (free level)
TEXT_EN.Missões de Selo da vila: 30.900 XP (os s: Village Seal missions: 30,900 XP (seals can be collected earlier)
TEXT_EN.The Venomous Requirement: 50 Snake Venom: The Venomous Requirement: 50 Snake Venom for Ko
TEXT_EN.Revenge on Kuraken: 8 tentáculos (antes,: Revenge on Kuraken: 8 tentacles (first donate Ryo to Kampo in Mist; easier for Mist)
TEXT_EN.Gobori's Odd Request: 23 caudas de Racco: Gobori's Odd Request: 23 Raccoon, Scorpion and Rat tails
TEXT_EN.Land of Spirits Arc: NPC Lv.60 Arc perto: Land of Spirits Arc: Lv.60 Arc NPC near Guren (100 Ryo)
TEXT_EN.História: Land of Spirits → Among the Yo: Story: Land of Spirits → Among the Yokai → Binding Ofuda → The Memory Lane
TEXT_EN.Break the Chain: derrotar os 4 Sound Nin: Break the Chain: defeat the 4 Sound Ninjas (490,400 XP)
TEXT_EN.Echos of Yokai I–V (Okuri): pesquisa dos: Echos of Yokai I–V (Okuri): yokai research, leads to The Whispering Well
TEXT_EN.Cleanse the Forest I–V (Nekomata): de Sp: Cleanse the Forest I–V (Nekomata): from Spiritevil Falls to Spiritstone Hollow
TEXT_EN.Matar 70 Mutant Rats no Leaf Village Sew: Kill 70 Mutant Rats in the Leaf Village Sewers, which only open with the Leaf seals.
TEXT_EN.Diária principal do Rogue: no 15, duas d: The Rogue's main daily: at 15, two of them give 1–2 levels.
TEXT_EN.PvP: só contam alvos até 10 níveis abaix: PvP: only targets up to 10 levels below you count.
Just rest at the village hot springs.
TEXT_EN.A janela de nível mais larga das diárias: The widest level window of any daily (19–50).
TEXT_EN.O XP não sobe com o nível: nos 40 rende: The XP doesn't scale with level: it pays little in the 40s.
TEXT_EN.PvP: cobrar recompensas de alvos do Bing: PvP: collect bounties on Bingo Book targets at the Bounty Station.
TEXT_EN.PvP: matar inimigos em Danger Zone ou Wa: PvP: kill enemies in a Danger Zone or War Zone; targets more than 10 levels below you don't count.
TEXT_EN.Bom XP para a faixa, mais 175 Ryo e 4 co: Good XP for the range, plus 175 Ryo and 4 consumables.
TEXT_EN.No Sand pede 30 Snake Venom (drop das Sn: In Sand it asks for 30 Snake Venom (dropped by Snakes in the Abandoned Lair) and 25 Spider Eggs (near Leaf); the items change by village.
TEXT_EN.Quase ninguém pega: farmar Snake Venom é: Almost nobody takes it: farming Snake Venom is awful.
TEXT_EN.Só escoltar um mercador até Kinsen Quart: Just escort a merchant to Kinsen Quarters.
TEXT_EN.Snakes do Abandoned Lair: combina com o: Abandoned Lair Snakes: fits the grind for this range.
TEXT_EN.As Venomous Snakes ficam no 2º andar, qu: Venomous Snakes are on the 2nd floor, which opens with The Venomous Requirement.
TEXT_EN.Entrar numa vila inimiga até o escritóri: Get into an enemy village, reach the Kage's office and get out alive.
TEXT_EN.Fica no mar (South Eastern Sea V); desde: It is at sea (South Eastern Sea V); since July 29, 2026 the Great Blood Shark, an enraged version, spawns there.
Escort the envoy to another village.
TEXT_EN.Roubar um pacote no mercado de outra vil: Steal a package from another village's market (PvP risk).
PvP: eliminate enemy ninja in Takumi.
TEXT_EN.PvP: matar alvos do Bingo Book \"B\" e c: PvP: kill Bingo Book "B" targets and claim at the Bounty Station.
TEXT_EN.Coleta de ingredientes para o herbalista: Ingredient gathering for the herbalist, like Medicine Supplies II.
TEXT_EN.Eliminar Jonin da Leaf em território ini: Eliminate Leaf Jonin in enemy territory.
TEXT_EN.Eliminar Jonin da Mist em território ini: Eliminate Mist Jonin in enemy territory.
One of the highest daily XP payouts.
Hunt the Dark Weasel in the deep desert.
TEXT_EN.Caçar o Dark Monkey King no Valley of th: Hunt the Dark Monkey King in the Valley of the End (War Zone).
